Maya (People Ops): Quick heads-up — small update to this cycle's deadlines and calibration cadence. TL;DR: reviewer assignments due by 2026-04-08 23:59 PT, self-reviews by 2026-04-02, calibration windows on 2026-04-10 and 2026-04-12. Please read below and flag blockers.
Samira Patel: Thanks — is there a published mapping of reviewers -> review loads? Need to know if I should reassign for bandwidth.
Maya (People Ops): Yep, we pushed a small change to reviewer loads this morning. See spreadsheet: https://redwood.app/sheets/review-loads (edit access to managers). If you're overloaded, reply here and we'll reassign.
Jordan Lee: Quick Q — contractors get a condensed form right? Do they follow the same calibration pool?
Maya (People Ops): Contractors use the 'Contractor Short Form' and are included in the same calibration sessions unless specifically excluded by manager request. If you need an exclusion, tag me @Maya. :wave:
Chris Nguyen: Form link? Also will we lock forms automatically?
Maya (People Ops): Form links:
- Manager review: https://redwood.app/forms/manager-review
- Self review: https://redwood.app/forms/self-review
- Contractor short form: https://redwood.app/forms/contractor-short
Yes, forms auto-lock at 2026-04-08T23:59:00-07:00 (PST). We'll send a 24h reminder and a last-minute unlock window only for documented exceptions.
review-bot: Reminder: reviewer assignments due in 5 days. /remind @channel in 3d to finalize assignments. :bell:
Samira Patel: Got it, will triage my queue today and ping if I need overflow.
Jordan Lee: If we need to swap calibrators, who signs off on the swap? My lead is OOO next week.
Maya (People Ops): If lead OOO, escalate to your manager's manager (PMM) or tag me with the reason. We'll approve reassignments within 24h.
Chris Nguyen: Noted. Sending manager invites for both calibration windows now. The first slot works for EMEA folks too?
Maya (People Ops): First window 09:00-11:00 PT should be friendly for EMEA afternoon. Second window is 13:00-15:00 PT for NA coverage. Use calendar invites with the 'calibration' tag.
Jordan Lee: Thanks — will update invites and assign backups. :thumbsup:
Maya (People Ops): Appreciate it. If anyone wants a quick 15-min sync to walk through weights or calibration rubric, DM me and I'll set up slots. Thanks! :sparkles:
